title.narrative: Strengthening laboratory diagnosis of TB in the region of the Americas

description.narrative: Multicountry Americas ORAS-CONHU - Tuberculosis - Organismo Andino de Salud - Convenio Hipólito Unanue - ORAS CONHU. This program has the following goals: Contribuir a mejorar la calidad del diagnóstico de TB en las redes de laboratorio mediante el fortalecimiento de las capacidades instaladas en la región / To contribute to improving the quality of TB diagnosis through capacity strengthening of the laboratory networks in the region. The objectives of this program are: Consolidar compromisos para la sostenibilidad de los LSN y los LRN en la región / To consolidate the sustainability commitments for the SRLs and NRLs in the region. Apoyar la adopción y operacionalización de recomendaciones internacionales de TB y el diagnóstico de TB MDR en políticas nacionales, monitorear su implementación y optimizar la utilización de equipos de TB a nivel nacional y regional / To support the adoption and operationalization of international recommendations in relation to TB and MDR-TB in national policies, monitor their implementation and optimize the use of TB equipment at national and regional levels. Contribuir al desarrollo, armonización e implementación de los sistemas de información en las redes nacionales y regionales de laboratorios de TB, con un enfoque inter-programático / To contribute to the development, harmonization and implementation of information systems in national and regional TB laboratory networks, with an inter-programmatic approach

title.narrative: Coverage / Output indicator for QRA-T-ORAS
M & E-Other1: Number of countries that adopt the mechanism for monitoring laboratory indicators
HSG-Other 1: Number of SRLs that meet sustainability commitments
Percentage of National Reference Laboratories accredited according to ISO15189 standard or achieving at least 4 stars towards accreditation

TB-other 1. Number of supranational laboratories (SRL) of TB that meet the six components defined in the terms of reference of SRL established by the Global Laboratory Initiative (GLI) of the Stop TB Partnership

TB- other 3: Percentage of NRL with quality control and external evaluation of drug sensitivity tests (DST) of first-line drugs (INH and RFP) with WHO internationally accepted criteria for each of the anti-TB drugs evaluated.
Percentage of new and relapse TB patients tested using WHO recommended rapid tests at the time of diagnosis
TB-other 2: Percentage of national laboratory networks (NLN) for TB that comply with standardized regional criteria for quality assurance of bacilloscopy.
TB-other 4: Number of SRL receiving financial support from the countries they support for the purpose of complying with their functions as network hubs
